label: copy phase, mid-sequence recall (outputting original tokens 3-4)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (100% of activation mass; essentially never on original or delimiter steps). It is positional: rate peaks at recall_idx 3-4 (~42%, 78% of mass), drops off at recall_idx 2 and 5, and is rare at 1 and 6+. It also fades on the last output step (to_go=0). Whether it fires and how strongly depends on token identity. Outputs h and i are strongest (out_tok rate 55%, lift 7x), followed by l and 2, and the largest activations come one step before an h/i output (next_out lift ~4.5x). Precision is low because many mid-recall steps with other tokens stay silent; token lists raise precision but cut recall, and none gave a cleaner single predicate.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: h, i, l, 2, v, g; least: t, q, c, f) and the next token to output (most: h, i, l, 2, g, v; least: a, c, w, t); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=3 & t=4.
